vibe_description: Awwwards Site-of-the-Month tier digital atelier portfolio for Socxio (2 Software Architects & 1 Brand/Marketing Strategist). Blends deep imperial burgundy wine textures, warm alabaster cream, stark architectural brutalism, interactive Three.js floating procedural sculptures, kinetic masked typographic hero reveals, 3D card tilt physics, and an interactive triumvirate Gateway entry.

the_gate_screen.interaction: Three towering monolith selector cards: TECH (Deep Dark Burgundy), BOTH (Cream & Wine Dualism), MARKETING (Rose-Burgundy). Hovering over each updates dynamic ambient lighting, displays teaser metrics, and tilts in 3D. Clicking initiates a fluid cinematic transition animating into the tailored scroll-story portfolio.
the_gate_screen.route_handling: State or URL hash (?view=tech, ?view=marketing, ?view=both) with seamless 'Back to Gate' switcher accessible from the sticky header.

threejs_webgl_canvas.description: Procedural interactive Three.js floating geometry canvas reacting to pointer move & scroll coordinates. Renders an elegant hovering wireframe icosahedron/torus knot with burgundy/rose/wine vertex points that glides and rotates organically in the background behind hero and transitions.
threejs_webgl_canvas.implementation: Native Three.js with requestAnimationFrame and mousemove lerp listener (or @react-three/fiber if compatible) inside a responsive canvas container with z-0 pointer-events-none.

css_3d_tilt_cards.description: Interactive mousemove tilt on cards calculation (rotateX, rotateY based on mouse offset from card center with smooth CSS transform transition and specular glare sheen effect).

masked_hero_text_reveal.description: Line-by-line overflow-hidden masked container text reveal using Framer Motion (staggered translateY from 100% to 0% with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)).

slow_editorial_marquee.description: Single ultra-slow, low-contrast typography ribbon drifting across the screen with quotes: 'NARRATIVE MEETS ARCHITECTURE — WHERE CODE CONVERTS — CRAFT OVER CONFORMITY — SOCXIO ATELIER MMXXVI'.

interactive_portfolio_filter.description: Tab toggle allowing instant view switching between Tech, Marketing, and Both without leaving the story flow, changing page background tint dynamically.

interactive_inquiry_drawer.description: Tactile Project Estimator & Scope Selector (Interactive budget slider, discipline checklist, timeline selector, and booking form with Sonner feedback).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace default App.js with the full Socxio experience featuring the landing Gate Screen and the three deep scroll-story views (Tech, Marketing, Both).
2. Implement the Three.js interactive floating 3D particle/geometric sculpture that shifts color and responsiveness as the user hovers or switches views.
3. Keep team photo containers as styled placeholder empty frames with elegant architectural grid lines, crosshair marks (+), role codes, and fictional bios ('Photo frame awaiting studio portrait').
4. Ensure mobile-first responsiveness down to 390px viewport width (tested with flex-col fallbacks on gate cards and horizontal swipe on mobile galleries).
5. Use Sonner for instant interactive feedback when users test inquiry triggers or copy email.
